articles.summary: Phase 2 studies ongoing to advance global development of vebreltinib, a highly potent, de-risked and differentiated c-MET Inhibitor with best-in-class and first-in-class potential. To date, more than 600 patients and 170 healthy volunteers have been dosed with vebreltinib in clinical trials.
